svg.title: Six transitions as frame strips (start, middle, end)
svg.text: Six transitions as frame strips (start, middle, end)
new frame moves in over the old one
old frame moves out, revealing the new one
new frame pushes the old one out
new frame slides over, old one shifts
old frame slides off, new one shifts in
Indigo is the starting frame, amber is the destination frame. Schematic; every moving frame travels to the left.
